answer.summary: E2E failed because the openaev-app container crashed at startup with a duplicate Flyway migration version, V6_20261121140000000. The change adds V6_20261121140000000__Add_finding_lifecycle.java, and the log shows another migration with the same version (Coverage_scenario_safe_mode_and_approval). Startup validation is deterministic, so a rerun will fail the same way. Fix the migration version collision.
